description.en: A self-hosted format-1 index containing the 小说模式 (Novel Mode) plugin.
description.zh: 自托管的 format-1 索引，收录「小说模式」插件。

description.en: From one idea to a finished, consistency-checked novel: a deterministic writing ENGINE for DeepSeek Harness, not a prompt pack. A JavaScript state machine owns 7 script-gated stages plus a 15-step serial per-chapter sub-FSM; PowerShell validators decide every gate, versioned atomic checkpoints resume at the exact chapter, 9 subagent workers are evidence-adjudicated in code, and the user sees only quiet structured status with zero prompt dumps, leaked errors or bundled credentials.
description.zh: 一个想法到一本校验通过的小说：DeepSeek Harness 的确定性写作引擎，不是提示词包。JavaScript 状态机掌握 7 个脚本硬门禁阶段与 15 步串行单章子状态机，版本化原子断点精确续写，9 个子代理由代码按证据裁决，用户只看到安静的结构化状态：无提示词、无错误外泄、零内置凭据。
